test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G, and K, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Only two people sit between D and G. Only E sits to the right of K. Only one person sits between G and K. C sits at some place to the right of B but at some place to the left of F.

Who sits third from the right end of the line?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people, B, C, D,
 E, F, G, and K, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only E sits to the right of K. 

2) Only one person sits between G and K. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1cc066f79d1646064561052155ed5e06560792b4befc0df90ad2526d147c82.png] 

3) Only two people sit between D and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8b7bb1c2217250cc59b6b5012a9a1665fc1e9431e8252813cd8525740c7a900.png] 

4) C sits at some place to the right of B but at some place to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc05428eaee086a5cd4bff8aae736650a3824abc0a50fea01066b9da47f94e2b.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, F sits third from the right end of the line.

Hence,** "Option 1"** is the correct answer.
